title: Cashier
description: Invoicing from orders, payments, transfers, and shifts.

approver.description: Above your limit a supervisor types their own username and password here.

shortcuts.title: Keyboard shortcuts
shortcuts.description: The cashier desk works without the mouse.
shortcuts.invoice: Create the invoice from the chosen lines

shift.noneHint: Open your shift to take payments.
shift.openDescription: Count the opening float handed to you and enter it.

lookup.title: Find patient
lookup.label: Patient search
lookup.placeholder: File no, visit no, phone or name
lookup.hint: Search by file number, visit number, phone or name, in Arabic or English.
lookup.noResultsHint: Check the spelling or search by phone or file number.

billing.title: Billing
billing.pickDescription: Find the patient on the left, then pick the visit to invoice and collect.
billing.nothingDescription: This visit has no requested lines and no invoices.

invoice.approveDescription: Prices freeze from today's price list and the invoice can no longer change. Corrections then need a credit note.
invoice.voidDescription: Its lines go back to requested and can be invoiced again.
invoice.cancelDescription: The line is cancelled and leaves the invoice (for example, the patient refused the test).

discount.title: Discount the patient share
discount.description: Discounts apply to the patient share only, need a reason, and show on the shift report with the approver's name.
discount.wholeInvoice: All lines, in proportion to the patient share

preapproval.title: Payer pre-approval
preapproval.description: This payer needs its approval number on the line before the invoice is approved.

creditNote.title: Credit note for {{number, bidi}}
creditNote.description: Choose whole units to credit. The invoice itself never changes; a supervisor approves the note.
creditNote.chooseLines: Enter at least one unit to credit.
creditNote.createdBody: A cashier supervisor approves it under Credit notes. Released patient money then opens a refund request.

payment.title: Payment
payment.tenderedShort: The cash handed over is less than the amount.
payment.spendRemainderHint: Oldest invoices first, any visit of this patient.
payment.noShiftBody: Money is only taken into the cashier's own open shift.

override.title: Reference already used
override.description: This bank reference was recorded before. Accept it only after checking, with a reason and a supervisor.
override.approver: A supervisor with the duplicate override permission types their credentials here.

receipt.pageDescription: Print on the 80 mm receipt printer or on A4.
receipt.title: Payment receipt
receipt.rejectedNote: Transfer rejected by the bank. This receipt is not valid.
receipt.reversedNote: Payment reversed ({{number, bidi}}). This receipt is not valid.
receipt.reversalNote: Reversal of payment {{number, bidi}}. Not a receipt for money received.
receipt.verifyHint: Scan to check this receipt at the center.

invoicePrint.pageDescription: Print the approved invoice on A4 or the 80 mm printer.
invoicePrint.title: Invoice
invoicePrint.payerNote: The payer share is claimed from the payer; it is not paid by the patient.

shiftPage.title: My shift
shiftPage.description: Live shift report, cash handovers, and the close with counted cash.

shiftDetail.title: Shift {{number, bidi}}
shiftDetail.description: The shift report as it stood at close; later effects show in the shift where they were booked.
shiftDetail.descriptionOpen: Live report of an open shift. It freezes when the shift closes.

close.title: Close shift
close.description: Count the cash in the drawer and enter it. A difference from the expected cash needs an explanation and alerts the manager.
close.varianceTitle: The count differs from the expected cash
close.varianceBody: Choose a variance reason. The manager reviews every variance.
close.confirmDescription: A closed shift never changes. Later effects post to the current shift.
close.doneBody: The report is frozen and waits for the manager's review.

handover.title: Hand over cash
handover.centerHint: A supervisor or an accountant confirms they received it. Until then it shows as in transit.
handover.cancelDescription: The cash comes back to your drawer.

transfers.title: Transfer verification
transfers.description: Check each transfer against the bank statement or app, then confirm or reject it. Pending money is never counted as collected.
transfers.confirmDescription: Confirm only after you saw the money in the bank statement or app.
transfers.rejectDescription: Its invoices return to outstanding. After the shift closed, the reversal is booked in your own open shift and the manager is alerted.
transfers.reversalBooked: Reversal {{number, bidi}} booked in shift {{shift, bidi}}.
transfers.reversedInShift: Reversed in its own open shift.

creditNotes.title: Credit notes
creditNotes.description: Corrections of approved invoices. A supervisor approves; released patient money becomes credit and may be refunded.
creditNotes.approveDescription: The credited units leave the invoice's balance; money the patient paid for them becomes credit.
creditNotes.openRefund: Open a refund request for the released money
creditNotes.rebillHint: Creates a new requested line for each fully credited line.

refunds.title: Refunds
refunds.description: Refunds come from approved credit notes, are approved by a second person, and are paid in cash from the paying cashier's shift.
refunds.requestDescription: Cash back to the patient from credit this credit note released. Another person approves it.
refunds.decisionDescription: Refund {{number, bidi}}. You cannot decide a refund you requested.
refunds.payDescription: Hand the cash to the patient. It leaves your open shift's drawer.

performFirst.title: Perform-first authorization
performFirst.description: Allow unpaid lines of one visit to be performed before payment, documenting who allowed it and why.
performFirst.pickDescription: Find the patient, pick the visit, then choose the lines to authorize.
performFirst.noLines: No open lines on this visit.
performFirst.doneBody_one: {{count}} line may now be performed before payment.
performFirst.doneBody_other: {{count}} lines may now be performed before payment.
performFirst.revokeDescription: Lines that have not started go back to pay-first. Work already performed stays covered.

review.pageDescription: Closed shifts with their variances and pending transfers. Sign off each one; never your own.
review.title: Review
review.formDescription: Check the variance, pending transfers, discounts and cancellations, then sign off or flag the shift.

receiptCheck.title: Check a receipt
receiptCheck.description: Scan a printed receipt's QR code, or type its number, to see whether the money stands.
receiptCheck.label: Receipt QR code or number
receiptCheck.hint: A barcode scanner types the code and presses Enter by itself.
receiptCheck.notFound: No payment has this receipt number. Check the number, or treat the receipt as not genuine.

standing.mismatch: Code does not match the payment

standingHint.valid: The payment was received and stands.
standingHint.pending: The money is recorded, but the bank has not confirmed the transfer yet.
standingHint.rejected: The bank did not receive this transfer. The receipt is not valid.
standingHint.reversed: This payment was reversed ({{number, bidi}}). The receipt is not valid.
standingHint.mismatch: The amount or date on this receipt differs from the payment. The receipt may have been altered.
